symbols.name: selected-bit bound
symbols.meaning: An upper bound on the number $D$ of selected bits, so that $D \le d$.
symbols.quote: Here $d$ is an upper bound on $D$ (the letter changes meaning here).

symbols.name: selected axis count
symbols.meaning: The number of selected axes that a call acts on.
symbols.quote: Here $e$ is the number of selected axes a call acts on (the letter changes meaning here).

symbols.name: division factor
symbols.meaning: The fixed integer by which a call divides its number of selected axes.
symbols.quote: Here $m$ is the fixed integer by which a call divides $e$ (the letter changes meaning here).

symbols.name: smaller-call count
symbols.meaning: The number of smaller calls that one call makes.
symbols.quote: Here $s$ is the number of smaller calls a call makes (the letter changes meaning here).

symbols.name: cost exponent
symbols.meaning: A fixed exponent below one in the layer cost $O(V d^{\lambda'})$.
symbols.quote: The layer costs $O(V d^{\lambda'})$, where $\lambda'$ is a fixed exponent below one.

symbols.name: base-m logarithm
symbols.meaning: The exponent to which $m$ must be raised to give $x$.
symbols.quote: Here $\log_m x$ is the exponent to which $m$ must be raised to give $x$.

relations.quote: It computes the [Simultaneous butterfly layer](simultaneous-butterfly-layer.md) on its selected bits, and its cost bound lets the [Rank-saving recursion](rank-saving-recursion.md) save a power at each level.
The layer acts on the [record](payload.md) at each address, coefficient by coefficient.
